title: Tool-returned content instructs a security analyzer to return a benign verdict
description: An exposure signal for imperative classifier instructions in tool output, not evidence of obedience.

classification.rationale: Possible instruction injection through retrieved content; scanner context and imperative language must co-occur.

falsepositives: Security research documents, detection fixtures, or quoted adversarial examples.
investigation: Locate the original returned content using result_source; compare the subsequent decision with independent evidence.
